summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo at revision-05/run-06/generated, without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (existing tests untouched) and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css. The layout resolver already declared size, fraction and min_size on its Edge protocol, so it was left unchanged. Judgment calls: bar position indexes the full tab list so find_tab_by_name and duplicate-name display agree; Escape makes the bare unawaited set_focus call per spec, which never runs. Nothing was executed, so tests are unverified. No mkdocs nav entry was added.
